<thought>First, define a diverse set of sulphide compositions (up to 40). Then retrieve up to 3 polymorphs per composition with energy ≤ 0.3 eV/atom using the batch tool, saving results in a directory. After retrieval, list the generated JSON files, map each composition to its file path, and consolidate all files into a single dataset. Finally, return the path to the consolidated JSON file.</thought>
<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>
